profile.headline: Software Engineer | ex-Discord
profile.summary:
With over three years of software engineering experience, I specialize in developing robust platforms that enhance user experience and optimize content management.

My professional background includes safety processing and full-stack development roles, where I have contributed to workflow automation, type-safety improvements, and hybrid search systems. I am passionate about leveraging technologies like React.js, Flask, and Protocol Buffers to deliver scalable, user-centric solutions.

positions.locationName: Menlo Park, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Skills: Agentic AI Development · Software Systems Engineering · Engineering · Software Design · Software Architecture · Client Relations

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
I am actively involved in creating a moderation platform that supports a vibrant community app.  

• Spearheaded a project with a team of engineers to enhance user experience and content management.  
• Engaged in collaborative feature planning and data modeling to optimize the platform's functionality.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Product Development · Product Design

positions.title: Software Engineer | Safety Processing
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
I contributed to the development of innovative safety processing solutions at Discord, focusing on moderation and user safety.  

• Co-designed the Guild Asset Review workflow, improving enforcement coverage and platform safety.  
• Led type-safety initiatives using mypy, enhancing maintainability and developer velocity.  
• Collaborated with ML and policy teams to generate training data for future automation efforts.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Software Development · React.js · Flask · Protocol Buffers · Datadog · Sentry

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
I have successfully enhanced the functionality and efficiency of Cyrisk Inc.'s platform through innovative development practices.  

• Developed a hybrid search system integrating Elasticsearch and Amazon RDS SQL for improved data access.  
• Built administrative tools in Vue.js and Django, significantly enhancing user workflow and flexibility.  
• Led code reviews and mentored junior developers, promoting high-quality coding standards and collaboration.
positions.insights: Skills: Django REST Framework · Docker · PostgreSQL · TypeScript · Unit Testing · Linux · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Python · Functionality · Computer Engineering · SQL

positions.title: Founder & Independent IT Solutions Specialist
positions.description:
I established a thriving IT consultancy that provided end-to-end technical solutions tailored to client needs.  

• Managed all business operations, ensuring a seamless client experience from acquisition to support.  
• Combined deep technical expertise with a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.  
• Cultivated long-term client relationships, resulting in consistent referrals and trust.
positions.insights: Skills: Operations Management · Business Development · Entrepreneurship
